snippet.title: Dear Journey... // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4172110/Dear_Journey

Run a cosy little travel agency, one letter at a time. Travellers write in and tell you what they are hoping for. Plan the journey that gives it to them, card by card, and watch it unfold. Satisfy them, and they may write back...

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Cosynook Games
📚 Publisher: Cosynook Games
📅 Release Date: Sep 20, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Strategy
